There is **no link** between the MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) vaccine and autism. This is the overwhelming scientific consensus.

The claim originated from a 1998 paper by Andrew Wakefield that has been **completely discredited** — it was retracted, Wakefield lost his medical license for serious ethical violations and fraudulent data manipulation, and multiple subsequent studies involving hundreds of thousands of children have found no association.

Major health organizations worldwide (WHO, CDC, NIH, etc.) all confirm the MMR vaccine is safe and does not cause autism. The original study has been thoroughly debunked through extensive independent research.
